snippet.title: Nijowari: Where Angels Fall Trailer
snippet.description:
Nijowari: Where Angels Fall is a rich visual novel with two main characters, each one with its own story and its own life.

Follow our hero's steps in this daring mix of plot-driven and slice-of-life visual novel with heavy character development and hard-hitting special effects.

Find it on Itch.io! https://kyoki-chiho.itch.io/nijowari-where-angels-fall

And on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1156980/Nijowari_Where_Angels_Fall/

If you want know more, follow me on Twitter @KyokiC and don't be afraid to take a look at my free Patreon https://www.patreon.com/motleyC
